## Gohl (Hydra Cloud) (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
CE Large aberration  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +25  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +10 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 168 (14d8+56)  
**Fort** +8; **Ref** +9; **Will** +12  
**Defensive Abilities** all-around vision; **DR** 10/silver  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 30 ft. (good)  
**Melee** 3 bites +15 (1d4+5 plus 1d6 acid), 6 tentacles +12 (1d6+2 plus grab)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (1d6+5)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 17, **Con** 19, **Int** 6, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +16 (+20 grapple); **CMD** 30 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Fly +9, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +5, Perception +25; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
**Languages** Common (can’t speak)  



**Ecology**


**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
